detail: Eleven sync scenarios on the Marianela Codex fixture (tests/codex_fixture.py plus 130 single-paragraph facts) were run with the old literary-critic aligner (origin/main) and with doc-control's diff (this branch), and every Report compared: report lines (item ids normalised), changed, lost and dependent items, renames and the moved-span count. Scenarios: identical draft, one edit, a consistent rename, a deleted paragraph, a 10-paragraph block moved, two inserted paragraphs, a split, a merge, and synth.generate edits at seeds 1/2/3 with rates 0.05/0.1/0.2. All 11 reports are identical. Every kept span lands at the same place; in the three synthetic scenarios 13 flagged (changed/lost) spans point the writer at a different neighbouring region (doc-control calls a 2-paragraph edit a split or modified where the old aligner said otherwise); their state and the flagged items are the same. The two gate tests also pass against the old aligner, so they pin the same report through both.

differences_from_old_aligner.notes: doc-control's diff has no 'large gap compared along a band' notes; alignment.json keeps a `notes` list (empty)
differences_from_old_aligner.moved_and_edited: doc-control's `moved` flag on a modified paragraph is kept as `moved: true` in alignment.json
differences_from_old_aligner.small_example: a short paragraph whose words reappear in an unrelated new one can be paired as modified+moved by doc-control; test_spans_lone_match_elsewhere_without_context_is_not_trusted now uses a paragraph edited in place

timing.how: in-process `lc diff v001 v002` and `lc codex sync` on .txt workspaces (v002 = synth.generate seed 5, rate 0.05; 200 facts, 2,000 for the doubled text), best of three, same machine

sync_100k_words_20k_spans_s.note: tests/test_sync.py::test_sync_100k_words_under_5s's sync; sync now loads drafts without the Codex scene lines it never used (query.load codex=False), which more than pays for the slower diff

timing.why_slower: both manuscripts are converted (.txt) and parsed as .docx by doc-control on every diff, where the old aligner read text/vNNN.txt
